_note: Data-mined pattern map of the channel's conceptual DNA. Counts are corpus mentions across 67 scripts / ~25.6k words (2026-07). Regenerate with concept/mine_corpus.py.

pillars.label: The ordinary / return to the body
pillars.essence: Every flight lands back in the room, the kitchen, the hands, the breath. The channel's signature and its psychological safety rail.

pillars.label: Self & identity as constructed
pillars.essence: The 'you' is a role, a mask, a narrative center — not a fixed thing behind the eyes.

pillars.label: Belief analysis / how you know
pillars.essence: Coherence vs. correspondence; checking beliefs against evidence you didn't author. The channel's core invitation.

pillars.label: Attention as the instrument
pillars.essence: What you aim at renders in high resolution; the rest is fog. Attention as budget, currency, graphics card.

pillars.label: The lens / you never see reality raw
pillars.essence: Window vs. mirror, filter, map vs. territory, the veil. Access is always mediated.

pillars.label: Memory as construction, not recording
pillars.essence: Every recall rewrites; the original is overwritten. Memory is an artist, not an archive.

pillars.label: Prediction & the constructed 'now'
pillars.essence: Perception runs a third of a second behind; the present is a forecast. The brain predicts, then corrects.

pillars.label: Emotion, love, and the turn
pillars.essence: The videos turn toward agency and love, never nihilism. Gratitude as a render command; the seal of being loved.

pillars.label: Mind as machine / rendering engine
pillars.essence: The reality-machine frame: loading screen, render distance, save file, graphics card, editor.

pillars.label: Recursion & self-reference
pillars.essence: The eye can't see itself; the observer observed; loops that fold back on the watcher.

pillars.label: Threshold / dissolution (DMT lane)
pillars.essence: Ego dissolution, entities, the border, becoming everything. Newest and smallest lane; high emotional voltage.
exemplars: The Other Side of the Door

structural_signatures: Disarming confessional or 2nd-person hook that pre-empts disbelief ('I know how that sounds, but listen').
One ruling metaphor system per script, held consistently (machine / ship / crossword / editor / customs).
A mechanism reveal — the trick is explained, not just asserted.
The reframe of fear: the scary reading is turned into an empowering one ('it should panic — it was never built to step outside the dream').
A grounding beat near the end (return to the room / body / ordinary object).
An open question handed to the viewer, never a decree. The invitation, not the instruction.
